QUOTE: The wrapper has no tokenizer wired. `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` returns `{}` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:796`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer lists the backend wrapper returning `{}` (an empty vector) when no tokenizer is wired as one of the failure signals. It also says a failed sized call yields an empty vector that `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` passes through as `{}`. So both cases give the same empty value.
